population: Exact cycle1 checkpoints and target pairings, including unmatched issuances. Original eligible-issuance predictions remain unchanged.
references: Exact current production HGB carried point
Frozen cycle1 selected hgb_l15_c3 checkpoint expert
activation: Only ineligible checkpoints with at least three different drivers whose latest eligible clean observations are strictly newer than the original HGB issuance and strictly earlier than this checkpoint; observations must be at most180 seconds old and within one numbered lap. Otherwise return the exact cycle1 point.
causality: Process global timestamp batches; no other-car updates from the same timestamp. Recorded eligibility and field publication latency remain retrospective assumptions. No future target flags, laps, durations, gaps or later peer state enter features or activation.
features: Cycle1 known features and point; new/current peer clean pace median/MAD/age/support; paired same-driver peer pace differences from records strictly preceding original issuance; same-compound and same-stint peer cohorts; current field pace minus stored prior field reference; robust own-minus-field offsets from up to6 earlier eligible observations and separate current-stint offsets. Insufficient support has explicit missing indicators. Forward observed stint/compound/pit-out resets only; future pit timestamps masked as in cycle1.

training.base_points: Reuse cycle1 expanding2022 base forecasts. Every stage1 expert score event is later than every expert-fit event.
training.selection: 2023 only, using base coefficients fitted2022 and cycle1 discovery expert fitted on2022 expanding base forecasts. Select minimum full-checkpoint event-balanced MAE with deterministic grid-order tie breaking.
training.final_fit: Selected peer residual refit on2022 cycle1-expert crossfit events12–22 plus2023 predictions from the cycle1 discovery expert; no2024–26 fitting. Compare transfer to exact bundled HGB and frozen final cycle1 expert.
training.weights: Equal total event weight over active peer-supported checkpoints.
training.candidate_family: HistGradientBoostingRegressor, absolute_error loss, learning_rate0.06,150 iterations,min_samples_leaf40,l2_regularization10,early_stoppingfalse,random_state20260908, target residual clipped±6seconds.

evaluation: All four variants reported. Equal-event full-checkpoint MAE plus equal-driver-target sensitivity, transition/neutralized/support subsets. 20000 paired event resamples, within-year circular three-event block intervals, per-event deltas and LOO. Historical2024/2025 and exposed2026 separate; compare each to production HGB and cycle1.
constraints: OneCPU, four variants only, no acquisition, no production/git changes, no cycle1 artifact edits, no transfer-driven reselection or second grid. Retrospective research only; no promotion.
